title: Link Kanbus editorial work to canonical Stories
description:
As an editor, I want the remaining production board behavior to use canonical CMS contracts.

Feature: Link Kanbus editorial work to canonical Stories
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given editorial work and a canonical Story in the same authorized publication
    When an editor links the work to that Story
    Then the stable relationship survives reload and the UI can navigate it without linking across unauthorized publications

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.
